$description: The MCP Apps host adapter: which host style variable each Division token takes inside an element with data-host="mcp". Host names are the McpUiStyleVariableKey set of @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps (Claude's design guidelines list the same 76). Division's own value is the fallback, so a host that omits a variable changes nothing. Emitted into src/styles/tokens.css by scripts/build-tokens.mjs; see scripts/lib/host-tokens.mjs for the checks.
